sous_titre: Indice d'exploitation de l'eau, en % des ressources renouvelables, 2022

Chypre.texte: Among the EU countries, Cyprus registered 71.0%, indicating that freshwater resources use was unsustainable.

Malte.texte: Malta and Romania had values of 34.1% and 21.0% in 2022.

Roumanie.texte: Malta and Romania had values of 34.1% and 21.0% in 2022.

Grèce.texte: Greece, Portugal and Spain with 13.8%,10.1% and 8.8% respectively, were below the threshold of 20%.

Union européenne.texte: In 2022, the EU WEI+ was 5.8%, an increase of 0.9 percentage points (pp) since 2000.
